pv30:1.1: Accherarūpam sugatassa ñāṇaṃ satthā yathā puggalaṃ vyākāsi ussannapuññā pi bhavanti h' eke parittapuññā pi bhavanti h' eke. || ||
pv30:2.1: Ayaṃ kumāro sīvathikāya chaḍḍito aṅguṭṭhasnehena yāpeti rattiṃ na yakkhabhūtā na siriṃsapā vā viheṭhayeyyuṃ katapuññakumāraṃ. || ||
pv30:3.1: Sunakhā p' imassa palihiṃsu pāde dhaṅkā sigālā parivattayanti gabbhāsayaṃ pakkhigaṇā haranti kākā pana akkhimalaṃ haranti. || ||
pv30:4.1: Na-y-imassa rakkhaṃ vidahiṃsu keci na osadhaṃ sāsapadhūpanaṃ vā nakkhattayogam pi na aggahesuṃ na sabbadhaññāni pi ākiriṃsu. || ||
pv30:5.1: Etādisaṃ uttamakicchapattaṃ rattābhataṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ nonītapiṇḍaṃ va pavedhamānaṃ sasaṃsayaṃ jīvitasāvasesaṃ. || ||
pv30:6.1: Tam addasā devamanussapūjito disvā va taṃ vyākari bhūripañño: ayaṃ kumāro nagarass' imassa aggakuliko bhavissati bhogato ca. || ||
pv30:7.1: Ki 'ssa vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko etādisaṃ vyasanaṃ pāpuṇitvā taṃ tādisaṃ paccanubhossat' iddhiṃ. || || Buddhapamukhassa
pv30:8.1: bhikkhusaṅghassa pūjaṃ akāsi janatā uḷāraṃ tatr' assa cittass' ahu aññathattaṃ vācaṃ abhāsi pharusaṃ asabbhaṃ. || ||
pv30:9.1: So taṃ vitakkaṃ pavinodayitvā pītiṃ pasādaṃ paṭiladdhā pacchā tathāgataṃ Jetavane vasantaṃ yāguyā upaṭṭhāsi sattarattaṃ. || ||
pv30:10.1: Tassa vataṃ taṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko etādisaṃ vyasanaṃ pāpuṇitvā taṃ tādisaṃ paccanubhossat' iddhiṃ. || ||
pv30:11.1: Ṭhatvāna so vassasataṃ idh' eva sabbehi kāmehi samaṅgibhūto kāyassa bhedā abhisamparāyaṃ sahavyataṃ gacchati Vāsavassā ti. || ||
